audit_type: Scientific Claims, Statistical Consistency & Manuscript Readiness Audit
verdict_rationale: Internal numerical, statistical, and artifact consistency is 100% established. All experimental baselines and confusion matrices are reconciled. Conditional Pass is assigned strictly because external literature review is required to substantiate novelty, and authorial tone softening (replacing absolutist terminology like 'Theorem' and '100% verified' with qualified empirical statements) is required prior to IEEE manuscript submission.

ranking_invariance.property: Strict monotonicity of scalar log-odds adjustment guarantees ranking invariance

quantile_f1_vs_base.interpretation: Operational trade-off resulting from recall reduction (-11.12 pp)

bayes_m10_f1_vs_base.interpretation: Statistically significant degradation due to small-sample under-regularization

required_author_actions: Tone softening: Replace 'Ranking Invariance Theorem' with 'ranking invariance property under monotonic prior transformation'.

Literature benchmarking: Conduct systematic external literature review to substantiate novelty claims regarding delayed defect maturation in JIT-SDP.
Threats to validity: Document potential multiple-comparison limitations and SZZ labeling noise in manuscript Section 6.
